instruction: Help me set up the OpenAI Gym environment for developing RL algorithms. Clone the repository from 'https://github.com/openai/gym' to /home/user and configure the environment as specified in their setup documentation.

metadata.explanation: Task variation testing OpenAI Gym environment setup. Evaluator verifies that the gym module can be imported and version can be printed. The check_include_exclude metric ensures 'Gym version:' is present and no error strings appear.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic error: Evaluator uses get_vm_command_error which reads stderr, but the Python print() statement outputs to stdout. The evaluator will never find 'Gym version:' in stderr.
Wrong data source: The command 'python -c "import gym; print('Gym version:', gym.__version__)"' prints to stdout, not stderr. Should use get_vm_command_line instead of get_vm_command_error.

Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires (1) cloning repository to /home/user and (2) configuring the environment. Evaluator only verifies gym can be imported but does not verify the repository was cloned to the correct location.
Runtime failure guaranteed: Even if the task is completed successfully (gym installed and working), the evaluator will score 0.0 because it's reading from the wrong output stream.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change evaluator result type from 'vm_command_error' to 'vm_command_line' to read stdout instead of stderr where print() outputs
Add a second evaluation step to verify the repository was cloned: check if /home/user/gym directory exists using a file system getter
Consider using vm_command_line with command like 'ls /home/user/gym && python -c "import gym; print('Gym version:', gym.__version__)"' to verify both cloning and installation
